aboutSection.title: Good food, with the city for a view.
aboutSection.subtitle: A little about us
content: Anna Cafe & Restaurant is a rooftop restaurant in Jodhpur serving Indian food, from tawa roti to dal fry and kadhai paneer.
Find a cosy corner among the plants and flowers, order something warm, and watch Jodhpur settle into the evening around you.

testimonialSection.description: What our guests say about us.

testimonials.content: The food was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich and authentic, and the presentation was beautiful. I highly recommend trying their signature dishes.
testimonials.author: Priya Sharma

testimonials.content: I had a wonderful dining experience at Anna Cafe & Restaurant. The staff was friendly and attentive, and the ambiance was cozy and inviting. I will definitely be coming back!
testimonials.author: Rohit Verma

testimonials.content: The rooftop seating with a view of Jodhpur is simply breathtaking. The food exceeded my expectations, and the service was top-notch. A must-visit for food lovers!
testimonials.author: Anjali Mehta
